bullets: Added GPT-6.1 Sol as a free-in-US, paid-elsewhere model in the picker, capped at one session per day for every account, shown with a promotional badge and $2.50/$12.50 per-million price ceiling below OpenAI's fast tier.
Added a launch-intent partner ad slot in the CLI composer that surfaces when you mention shipping, deploying, or demoing your work, alongside a PR-focused row for other mentions.
Fixed the streak bonus display for east-of-Pacific users so it now shows as a daily allowance lift rather than a wallet credit, describing when it lands and when the allowance reset removes it.
Fixed the SDK read override to send whole files on the edit path, so str_replace can match content past the ~65K truncation on hosted surfaces.
Fixed unclosed head think tags so they re-emit as text when the model ends a step on its own, instead of swallowing the rest of the answer into the thinking box.
Added post-click return tracking to the CLI so the next submitted prompt after an ad click (or a second ad click) records the click-to-return latency and resolution.
Added source tags to ad request messages so the auction can tell developer-typed input apart from runtime-synthesized messages like step notes or error summaries.
Added UTM tagging to free model picker referral links, appending Freebuff default tags to advertiser-domain links while leaving existing tags and code-span links untouched.
Improved VPN users' Freebucks notice to state that more models and Freebucks are available on a direct connection, since the VPN pool is smaller than the rest of limited access.
Added a residential proxy notice that names the likely cause when a household line is only flagged as a residential proxy and anonymous, rather than giving generic VPN advice.
Simplified prompt-error handling to return a state snapshot of the initial state instead of the live session, preventing post-error writes from bleeding into persisted state.
Improved steering messages to be framed as mid-turn so models keep the running task instead of treating a bare message as a whole new request.
Added invoiced CPM value to placement totals so advertisers can see delivery value counted at frozen CPM outside Freebuff's pay-per-click system.
Removed the Freebuff web chat surface from the house ad catalog, dropping that surface and its fallback copy from the subscription promotion catalog.
Updated release download origin checks to only accept https overrides to codebuff.com or freebuff.com hosts, refusing non-semver versions so malformed versions cannot escape a directory.
Added terminal text sanitization and strict release version validation to the release launcher so steered or malformed versions cannot rewrite a download path.
Added fatigue-layer scalar aggregates to the first-party decision allowlist so fatigue-signal visibility is captured in operational telemetry without reintroducing user-level identifiers.
Added trace evidence storage of raw token usage minus cost, so billed credits are not double counted against provider-reported usage for BYOK routing.
Published Freebuff CLI versions 0.1.6 through 0.1.9, each advancing the release manifest to ship bundled Shared/Core, Agent Runtime, and CLI updates.
Added OpenRouter lane pinning for Muse Spark to the meta endpoint with a price ceiling, so traffic cannot be rerouted to a cheaper host after the direct Meta key was blocked.
